summary: @ornikar/webpack-config 12.0.6 ships preinstall Bun-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: Version 12.0.6 of @ornikar/webpack-config does not contain webpack configuration code. The declared main entry `index.js` is absent from the tarball, and package.json declares `scripts.preinstall: "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with `_0xNNNN`-style identifiers and, at `npm install` time, downloads a Bun runtime archive from the oven-sh GitHub releases, extracts and chmod+x's the Bun binary, and then invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a ~727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` file using string-array-rotation obfuscation (a `WV8StW` shift routine over a large numeric/character array, a `hc1jfK9` custom-alphabet decoder, hex-mangled identifiers) whose contents are not inspectable in the shipped form. The alternate-runtime hop is used to execute opaque code on the installer under a runtime that Node-based scanners do not trace. The combination of a missing declared main, an obfuscated preinstall dropper, an alternate JS runtime unnecessary for a webpack-config package, and a large obfuscated sibling payload is consistent with a hijacked/compromised publish of this namespace rather than the legitimate maintainer release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
